text.en: One-shot handheld Grenade Launcher. Projectiles release a fan of three energy waves on contact with the ground.

Fires three wave-frame grenade launcher projectiles.

Each projectile does the damage of a legendary wave-frame and reaches 45% further (up to ~22 meters).

Fires three wave-frame grenade launcher projectiles that <pve can /> <pvp [cannot] /> deal overlapping damage.

Each projectile does the full damage of a legendary wave-frame and reaches 45% further (up to ~22 meters).

Fires three wave-frame grenade launcher projectiles that <pve can /> <pvp [cannot] /> deal overlapping damage.

Each projectile deals <pve 581 /> <pvp [?] /> damage and travels 12 meters across the ground.
